items.name: Scimitar
items.description: This one-handed curved blade is sharp on one side.

defensiveAbilities.name: Runic Resistance
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The maftet takes damage from a Strike or spell effect

Effect The maftet's protective runic tattoos glow, granting them resistance 5 to one damage type dealt by the triggering attack.

This resistance applies against the triggering effect and lasts for 1 minute or until the maftet uses this ability again, whichever comes first. If the triggering effect deals multiple damage types, the maftet chooses which type to resist.

Effect: Runic Resistance

offensiveAbilities.name: Paired Strike
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The maftet is wielding two scimitars

Effect The maftet makes two Strikes against the same target, one with each of their scimitars. The maftet combines the damage of any attacks that hit and applies resistances and weaknesses only once. This counts as one attack when calculating the maftet's multiple attack penalty.

offensiveAbilities.name: Powerful Scimitars
offensiveAbilities.description: Any non-magical scimitar becomes a +1 striking scimitar while a maftet wields it.

offensiveAbilities.name: Raptor Dive
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The maftet is flying at least 10 feet above the target

Effect The maftet Flies up to twice their fly Speed and makes a Paired Strike at the end of the movement. If both Strikes hit, the target is also knocked Prone.

cantrips.name: Sigil
cantrips.description:
You harmlessly place your unique magical sigil, which is about 1 square inch in size, on the targeted creature or object. The mark can be visible or invisible, and you can change it from one state to another by using an Interact action to touch the target. The mark can be scrubbed or scraped off with 5 minutes of work. If it's on a creature, it fades naturally over the course of a week. The time before the mark fades increases depending on your heightened level.

Heightened (3rd) The sigil instead fades after 1 month.

Heightened (5th) The sigil instead fades after 1 year.

Heightened (7th) The sigil never fades.

lv1spells.name: Sanctuary
lv1spells.description:
You ward a creature with protective energy that deters attacks. Creatures attempting to attack the target must attempt a Will save each time. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends.

Critical Success Sanctuary ends.

Success The creature can attempt its attack and any other attacks against the target this turn.

Failure The creature can't attack the target and wastes the action. It can't attempt further attacks against the target this turn.

Critical Failure The creature wastes the action and can't attempt to attack the target for the rest of sanctuary's duration.

lv1spells.name: Sure Strike
lv1spells.duration: until the end of your turn
lv1spells.description: The next time you make an attack roll before the end of your turn, roll it twice and use the better result. The attack ignores circumstance penalties to the attack roll and any flat check required due to the target being Concealed or Hidden. You are then temporarily immune to sure strike for 10 minutes.
